draft.title: Postwar Japan
card: Japan surrendered in 1945 after World War II. Allied forces then occupied the country until 1952. Most of the occupation was led by the United States, under General Douglas MacArthur.

The occupation brought a new constitution in 1947. It made Japan a democracy, with an elected parliament called the Diet. The emperor stayed, but only as a symbol of the state, without political power.
Article 9 of the constitution gave up war as a way to settle disputes. Japan agreed not to keep armed forces for war. Later it built Self-Defence Forces, which it describes as being for defence only.
Japan then rebuilt its industry. From the 1950s its economy grew very fast, helped by exports such as cars and electronics. By the late 1960s it was one of the world's largest economies.
draft.remember: Defeat and occupation led to a democratic, peaceful constitution, and then to rapid economic growth.

a.q: What did the new Japanese constitution of 1947 do?
opts: It made Japan a democracy and gave up war
It made the emperor the ruler with full power
It let the Allies govern Japan permanently
It built up Japan's army for overseas conquest
a.why: The constitution set up an elected parliament and gave the emperor only a symbolic role. Article 9 gave up war as a way to settle disputes. It did not restore the emperor's power, because he became a symbol of the state.
a.clue: Think about who held power and what Article 9 said about war.

b.q: In the 1960s a visitor to Japan sees new car factories and busy exports. Which statement best explains how this was possible after 1945?
opts: Japan rebuilt its industry and grew by exporting goods
Japan's army took resources from nearby countries
The Allies kept Japan under occupation to run its factories
The emperor ordered the economy to grow by decree
b.why: After 1945 Japan rebuilt its industry and from the 1950s grew fast, helped by exports such as cars and electronics. Taking resources by force belongs to the earlier empire, and the occupation ended in 1952. The emperor had only a symbolic role.
b.clue: Check which options fit the years after 1952 and a peaceful constitution.

a.best: It made Japan a democracy and gave up war

b.best: Japan rebuilt its industry and grew by exporting goods
